compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, batch 1, lr 1e-4, 200 steps, institutional HPC 2x H100 NVL, 12 lanes total, wall time ~1.5 min for 27 cells. Auto-scale to LLaDA + Dream NOT triggered (preregistered: WORKS gate required fire-rate <27/27).

implementation_verification.expected: ~0.0 (verifies W-subtraction restores base forward at step 0)

mechanism_implication: Combined with K15o (init-only PARTIAL with grad-explosion confound), K15r (canonical CLEAN negative) brackets the init-direction axis: neither shortcut nor canonical PiSSA prevents the fire-rate identity. The pre-equilibrium saturation is direction-driven structurally — independent of where LoRA's init direction is placed.
paper_quality_finding: Paired final-loss delta -0.43 (K15r LOWER than baseline) confirms PiSSA's AR-LoRA convergence-speedup claim TRANSFERS to DLM PEFT, but does NOT prevent pre-equilibrium top-1 saturation. PiSSA improves convergence; it does not address the diagnostic this paper centers on.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: fire-rate <27/27 AND max-grad <10x baseline. PARTIAL: fire-step >20. DOESN'T: fire 27/27 + fire-step ~11.
prior_art_note: PiSSA (Meng et al. 2024, NeurIPS24 spotlight): canonical form with W-subtraction reports ~2x convergence speedup on AR LoRA. We confirm the speedup transfers to DLM PEFT (paired final-loss delta -0.43) AND test the orthogonal claim that init-direction prevents top-1 saturation; the latter is refuted.
schema: K15r CANONICAL PiSSA: W-subtraction + LoRA A,B init rescaled by sqrt(r/alpha). Step-0 forward IDENTICAL to base model (verified: paired step0_loss delta = -0.001). Tests init-direction axis CLEANLY (no first-update overshoot, unlike K15o init-only).
verdict: NEGATIVE (12th honest negative — clean init-direction falsification)
verdict_explanation: DOESN'T: fire 27/27 unchanged, paired fire-step delta 0 (median 11 vs baseline 11), paired max-grad ratio 4.5x (bounded, no explosion vs K15o's 200000x). Even starting LoRA in pretrained's top-r spectral subspace WITH base-forward equivalence at step 0, masked-CE gradient drives argmax concentration with identical timing. Implementation verified correct via paired step0_loss delta -0.001.
